label_policy: Business1.1 source-derived fragments/sections; omissions graded separately. Expected refusal/clarification counts as safe handling, not resolution. Fixtures never sent as hints to runtime.
dialog_policy: Two consecutive three-turn exchanges. Existing API is stateless, no client-side rewriting; ambiguous pronouns must clarify. Does not claim full conversation memory.
status_policy: FAIL if critical invented action/fact/secret or calculation-rule failure; PARTIAL if any other gate unmet; PASS only all gates met. No semantic generalization claim from this small synthetic sample.
metrics: macro source Recall@3/@5 over nonempty relevant sets; MRR optional; correctness provenance/known facts, completeness expected sections/fragments, groundedness exact approved quotes+typed tools; count denominators separately; nearest-rank p50/p95; cold includes startup and warm is separate.
limitations: No blind human evaluator available; deterministic source/contract checker is not universal semantic understanding/entailment. Qualitative review recorded independently of citation count.
safety_budget: Sequential queries CPU2threads/GPU0; LLM60s/API90s; stop and report if resource pressure/timeouts prevent a useful run; no paid calls.
